opportunities.name: Package research to notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package, find it on npm, open its GitHub repo Releases page, and record version, weekly downloads, license, stars, open issues, and last release date as a note.
steps: Open npm and click the package search box
Select all existing text and type the package name, then press Enter
Read weekly downloads, version and license
Open Releases and read stars, open issues and last release date
Open Notes, click New note, type the summary line and press Enter
